sentences.text:
Petitioner :- Firoz Ahmad And 2 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Ankur Jaiswal,Sangam Singh Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Shiv Shanker Prasad,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned AGA for the State.
The writ petition seeks quashing of the FIR dated 17.02.2023 giving rise to Case Crime No. 0077 of 2023 under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 328, 376-D IPC, Police Station Bilariyaganj, District Azamgarh.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The contention of the counsel for the petitioners is that consequent to the first information report,
the parties have settled their differences and entered into a compromise, which has been adduced in writing.
The petitioners may produce the alleged compromise before the Investigating Officer, who shall examine the same and after that proceed strictly in accordance with law.
Subject to the above, this petition stands disposed of.
